digest.component_or_area: LLM runner and weekly integration/eval jobs
propositions: Token usage data (input/output/cache tokens and request count) from LLM calls in the external and eval-live weekly jobs is not captured or retrievable, though it is computed in PydanticAIRunner.run but dropped by callers and swallowed by NullHandler logging.
A new usage_log module with record() and summarize() functions should record usage to a JSONL file when REBAR_USAGE_LOG env var is set, and generate a Markdown summary table for GitHub job summaries.
PydanticAIRunner.run must call usage_log.record() immediately after computing _usage to hook both weekly jobs at a single seam point.
Both weekly jobs must set REBAR_USAGE_LOG to a temp path, append the summarize output to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY with if: always(), and upload the raw JSONL artifact.
